items.text: Game is very difficult to even make it out of the spawn area.  often tutorials dont even populate after reloading a save to see if you missed something.  tried for almost an hour and never found my ship.  Game leaves too much to be assumed  and with the art style and UI its hard to see just about anything.  I wanted to give it a fair shot but after an hour of struggling i just refunded and got my 20 bucks back.
items.text_zh: 这游戏连离开出生区域都非常困难。经常在重新加载存档看看是否漏掉了什么之后，教程甚至都不出现。试了将近一个小时，也从未找到我的飞船。游戏留下了太多需要猜测的东西，而且以这种美术风格和UI，几乎什么都很难看清。我想给它一个公平的机会，但在挣扎了一个小时后，我还是退款拿回了我的20块钱。

observations.evidence: Game is very difficult to even make it out of the spawn area
observations.evidence_zh: 游戏非常难，甚至连出生区域都很难走出去
